pages.text: $(#FF4444)🍉 Crimson Ice Core · Gale Concerto 🌿$()$(br2)$(l)$(#98FB98)「Let midsummer rush through your veins, turning gravity into a mere joke」$()$(br)When the sweetness of $(#FF4444)Scarlet Melon Flesh$() meets the icy sting of $(#3CB371)Frost Mint$(), and $(#87CEEB)Permafrost Crystals$() collide with $(#FFD700)Sunlight Sugar Grains$() within the $(#FFB6C1)Coral Chalice$()—a seasonal miracle is born, capable of granting $(l)temporary anti-gravity privileges$() to mortal flesh.

$(#FF4444)▌ Dual-Stage Euphoria $()$(br2)$(l)$(#98FB98)🦘 Kangaroo Moment$()$(br)A light tap of the foot allows $(#3CB371)triple leaps$().$(br2)$(l)$(#00BFFF)🌪 Wind at Your Back$()$(br)While running, trails of $(#87CEEB)frosty mist$() follow behind.

$(br2)$(#3CB371)▌ Ice-Chilling Craft $()$(br)- Extract juice from $(#FF4444)Watermelon Flesh$() and combine it with $(#87CEEB)Ice Wedges$() for $(#00BFFF)low-temperature aging$().$(br)- $(#3CB371)Mint Leaves$() must be soaked in $(#FFD700)Sugar Frost$() until they become $(#7FFF00)emerald translucent$().$(br)- While mixing, stir using $(#FFB6C1)gentle force$() at a speed of $(#9370DB)one rotation per second$().$(br2)$(#FF69B4)※$() A perfect brew will reveal $(#FF4500)rainbow-colored vortices$().

$(br2)$(#006400)『 Desert Traveler’s Journal 』$()$(br)A record from an oasis caravan stone tablet:$(br)'After sipping this $(#FF4444)solidified midsummer$(),$(br)I found myself leaping over $(#3CB371)three camels' backs$() in succession—$(br)while my $(#00BFFF)sprint$() stirred up a $(#87CEEB)blizzard of frost$(),$(br)even the $(#8B0000)blazing sun$() had to $(#FFD700)retreat in awe$().'
